knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Cape Dental Care is currently accepting new patients for each of our amazing dentists: Dr. Linda Kornienko, Dr. Kyle Radomski, Dr. Phillip Kraver, and Dr. Mark Kraver. From simple cleanings to complex Smile Reconstructions we've got you covered! Our services include general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, smile makeovers, oral surgery, IV sedation, dental implants, wisdom teeth, Invisalign, BOTOX, and more. We also design and manufacture our crowns, veneers, dentures and other restorations in own dental lab, managed by James Kraver, a Certified Dental Technician. From our family to yours, welcome to Cape Dental Care!"

posts.description:
Regain Confidence and a Healthy Smile with Implant-Supported Dentures.

Are you tired of struggling with missing teeth or uncomfortable dentures? Do you dream of enjoying a healthy diet and an active social life? If either of those questions applied to you, implant-supported dentures may be the solution.

Read more: https://capedental.com/are-implant-supported-dentures-right-for-you/

IV Sedation in the Dental Office: Is It Safe?

Many people experience anxiety when visiting the dentist, which can make even simple procedures stressful. Fortunately, advancements in sedation dentistry offer options that allow patients to relax and receive necessary care comfortably. One of the most effective methods is IV sedation, a safe option when handled by trained professionals like those at Cape Dental Care. But what exactly is IV sedation, and is it right for you? Let’s break it down.

Read more: https://capedental.com/iv-sedation-in-the-dental-office-is-it-safe/

Dental Implant Case Study: Transforming a Fractured Tooth into a Beautiful, Healthy Smile

We recently completed a complex dental implant procedure for a patient with a long history of dental issues. This case involved an old root canal-treated tooth that had been crowned over 30 years ago. When the patient’s crown snapped off unexpectedly, she came in seeking to have the crown recemented. Unfortunately, the entire tooth had fractured at the gumline, making it impossible to recement or place a new crown, even with a post.

Read more: https://capedental.com/dental-implant-case-study-transforming-a-fractured-tooth-into-a-beautiful-healthy-smile/

What You Should Know About Dental Implants.

Missing teeth can impact more than just your smile—they affect your ability to speak, chew, and even your confidence. Thankfully, modern dentistry offers a permanent solution that restores both function and aesthetics: dental implants. At Cape Dental Care, we believe in educating our patients about the process, benefits, and importance of choosing an experienced provider for this life-changing procedure.

Read more: https://capedental.com/what-you-should-know-about-dental-implants/
